Bearer.description: Enter the Heimdall JWT bearer token.

200.description: The attachment's bytes, as the content type it was uploaded with: one of FORTUNA_UPLOAD_ALLOWED_CONTENT_TYPES, which are these three by default.
The export itself, when it is small enough to deliver at once; a larger one is queued (202).
The export's record (JSON) while it is pending or failed; the file once it is completed.
The job's report (JSON) until the archive is ready; the ZIP archive once it is.
